description: Reverse-ETL e-signature activation: create and send a DocuSign envelope from a template for each row of an upstream DataFrame (`POST /envelopes` with templateId + templateRoles). Creates REAL envelopes and, by default, immediately emails a signature request the moment this asset materializes.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one DocuSign envelope created from a template, personalized via tabs_map / email_subject_template.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (envelopes_sent / envelopes_failed / rows_skipped_no_recipient / first_envelope_ids). No downstream data -- the send side effect is a real DocuSign envelope + signature-request email.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: DocuSign template ID (GUID) the envelope is built from.

role_name.label: Role Name
role_name.description: Template recipient role name to assign the resolved email/name to.

recipient_email_column.label: Recipient Email Column
recipient_email_column.description: Upstream column holding the recipient's email address.

recipient_name_column.label: Recipient Name Column
recipient_name_column.description: Upstream column holding the recipient's full name.

tabs_map.label: Tabs Map
tabs_map.description: Upstream column -> template text-tab tabLabel, to prefill from row values.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (blast-radius safety cap, not a rate limit).

name: DocuSign Envelope Send
